title: Truth in Contrast: Calibrated Factual Evidence from Language Model Likelihoods
abstract: arXiv:2610.23527v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) encode substantial factual knowledge. Yet, estimating confidence in factual claims reliably remains challenging. We study likelihood-based factual confidence from the complementary perspectives of discrimination and calibration across multilingual factual statements. Specifically, we instantiate contrastive generative likelihoods as Contrastive Factual Evidence (CFE), which compares the likelihood of the same claim under competing factual and non-factual conditions, and derive its probabilistic counterpart, the Contrastive Factual Posterior (CFP). We show analytically that CFP calibration depends on the differential error between the two surrogate conditionals, allowing errors shared across them to cancel and yield tighter calibration bounds. translated_title: 对比中的真相：来自语言模型似然的校准事实证据
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）编码了大量的事实知识。然而，如何可靠地估计事实性声明的置信度仍然是一个挑战。我们从判别与校准这两个互补的视角，在多语言事实性陈述上研究基于似然的事实置信度。具体而言，我们将对比生成似然实例化为对比事实证据（CFE），其比较同一声明在事实性与非事实性两种相互竞争的条件下的似然，并推导出其概率化的对应形式——对比事实后验（CFP）。我们从理论上分析证明，CFP的校准取决于两个代理条件分布之间的差异误差，这使得两者之间共享的误差能够相互抵消，从而获得更紧的校准界限。实证结果表明，CFP在保持与其最强竞争对手相当的事实判别能力的同时，显著提升了校准性能。尽管如此，判别能力在……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出对比事实证据（CFE）及其概率形式对比事实后验（CFP），通过比较同一声明在事实与非事实条件下的似然差异，使共享误差相互抵消，从而在多语言事实陈述上显著提升置信度校准性能并保持较强的事实判别能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Contrastive Factual Evidence (CFE) and its probabilistic counterpart, the Contrastive Factual Posterior (CFP), which compare the likelihood of the same claim under factual versus non-factual conditions so that shared errors cancel out, substantially improving calibration while maintaining strong factual discrimination across multilingual statements.
